stem: A paediatrician wants a stimulant preparation likely to cover the whole school day and homework period with one morning dose; which preparation has the longest stated duration?
explanation: Concerta has the longest stated duration at 12 hours, making it the best option for coverage across the school day and homework period.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 85

optionExplanations.A: Correct because Concerta is listed as lasting 12 hours, which is longer than the other preparations given.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because short-acting methylphenidate is listed as lasting 3-4 hours.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because short-acting dexamphetamine is listed as lasting 3-4 hours.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because Ritalin LA is listed as lasting 7-8 hours.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because lisdexamfetamine is listed as lasting 10-12 hours, which does not exceed Concerta’s stated 12 hours.
